gold: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue (GCT-ST)

selector.rationale: Multinodular proliferation of osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells and positive immunohistochemistry for CD68 support Giant Cell Tumor diagnosis

rejected.label: Rosai-Dorfman Disease
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and absence of characteristic histiocytes

rejected.label: Hodgkin Lymphoma
rejected.why: Patient's history of Hodgkin lymphoma is noted, but current presentation and histopathology do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: PALB2-related tumor
rejected.why: Genetic testing revealed a splicing variant in PALB2, but this is not sufficient to support a PALB2-related tumor diagnosis given the clinical and histopathological findings
